seo_title: Wi-Fi signal graphs and roam log
seo_description: Free, open-source macOS menu bar app that graphs Wi-Fi signal, noise and rate live and logs every roam and channel change. Local only, no account.
hero_sub: WifiRoamLog lives in your menu bar, graphs Wi-Fi signal, noise and transmit rate live, and logs every roam and channel change. Click the menu bar item to open it.
features_sub: Everything you need to debug flaky wireless, running natively on your Mac with no server and no account.

features.title: Live signal, noise and rate
features.desc: Three stacked charts show signal, noise and transmit rate, polled every 1, 2 or 5 seconds. Keep 15 minutes, 30 minutes or an hour of history.

features.title: Status in the menu bar
features.desc: Show dBm and rate, a percentage, or a quality rating. The popover adds network name, band, channel, BSSID and SNR.

features.title: A log of every event
features.desc: Network switches, roams between access points, channel and band changes, connects, disconnects and wake from sleep are recorded with old and new values.

features.title: Searchable, exportable history
features.desc: The log window lists events newest first and can be cleared or exported to a plain-text file. It is capped at 10,000 entries.

features.title: Optional roam notifications
features.desc: Turn on notifications to be told when your Mac roams or changes channel, so you can match drops to the moment they happened.

features.title: Quality rating from SNR
features.desc: Signal-to-noise ratio is mapped to Poor, Fair, Good or Excellent. Launch at login is available in Settings.

permissions_step: When prompted, allow Location access (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services) so macOS can reveal the network name and BSSID; the app still works without it.

faq.q: Is WifiRoamLog really free and open source?
faq.a: Yes. It is released under the MIT license and the full source is on GitHub. There are no ads, accounts or telemetry, and an optional Ko-fi button is the only way to support it.

Location (When In Use) is requested because macOS hides the Wi-Fi network name and BSSID from apps without it; your location is never read or stored. Without it, signal, noise, rate and channel changes are still graphed and logged. Notifications and login item access are only used if you enable those options.
Only on your Mac. The event log is a JSON lines file at ~/Library/Application Support/WifiRoamLog/events.jsonl, and nothing is sent to any server.
Notarization requires a paid Apple Developer account, which this free project does not have. Right-click the app and choose Open once to launch it, or build it from source with Xcode.
